brief:
Thousands of demonstrators joined pro-Palestinian marches in London, Berlin and Dublin on Saturday, Al-Monitor reported. The protesters called for an end to Israeli strikes on Gaza, with the demonstrations reflecting ongoing pressure in European cities over the conflict.

The coordinated marches marked continuing mobilization across multiple countries around Gaza-related issues, drawing large crowds to central locations in three major European capitals.
